naming_defects: The LIVE applied C_rad table (A) is quarantine-resident under a directory named for an e/sigma-photon VARIANT study (esigma_photon_variant_2026-09-26/empz45_nominal), with no generator tag in the file name, among genuine variant siblings; its content is the documented blind DJANGOH14 FINAL nominal table. Mislocation/mislabeling trap (content is faithful); the applied table is also superseded for Born-level use by the xFcut baseline (BLK-7.1).
No other naming-vs-content mismatch: B and C contents match their directory names and validation JSONs.

djangoh14_xfcut_availability.note: reproduces BLK-7.1 (+0.37/+0.41% blind under-correction, bias confined to z<0.05 bins)

generator_spread_fixed_definition.definition: rel(bin) = (C_rad_RAPGAP31 - C_rad_DJANGOH14)/C_rad_DJANGOH14 at matched definition: recomputed current-hemisphere xFGen<0 on both RAD and NONRAD legs, EMPZ>45, nominal variant. DJANGOH14 (table B) is the nominal; RAPGAP31 (table C) is the cross-check.
generator_spread_fixed_definition.percentile_convention: 0-indexed sorted position floor(p/100*(N-1)) (numpy 'lower' method); index-identical to nearest-rank for p5/p50, one rank lower for p95. Reproduces the durable-doc Step-2 table.
generator_spread_fixed_definition.doc_crosscheck: all statistics reproduce CRAD_UNC_GENERATOR_SPREAD_2026-10-07.md Step 2 to <=0.0005 pp; integrated values from sum(sigma_nonrad)/sum(sigma_rad): DJANGOH14 1.1418534/1.1413756, RAPGAP31 1.1368045/1.1362373

significance.combined_mcstat_definition: u_comb = sqrt(u_DJANGOH14^2 + u_RAPGAP31^2) from per-bin relative_stat_unc of tables B and C

global_max_sigma.note: high-statistics bulk bins: even sub-percent differences are overwhelmingly significant there; the MC-stat limitation is confined to the sparse high-z/high-pT tail

charge_correlation_signed_rel.note: matched-bin h+ vs h- correlation; comparable to ibu_model_rel's charge correlation (+0.51 signed per docs/systematics/systematics_signal_vs_noise_2026-10-03.md), i.e. a coherent model difference, not white noise

generator_spread_fixed_definition.structure_note: spread rises monotonically with z (z-row medians 0.54/0.52% at z<0.05 to 2.69/2.51% at z 0.7-1.0) and concentrates at high pT (all top-5 bins pT 4-8 or 2-4 GeV); signed distribution has both signs (p5 negative, p95 positive, integrated -0.44/-0.45%)

definitions.rel_def: (B - A)/A: definition-only shift, blind -> xFGen<0 xFcut, within DJANGOH14
definitions.rel_gen: (C - B)/B: generator spread at matched xFcut (= generator_spread_fixed_definition)
definitions.rel_mixed: (C - A)/A: the previously quoted MIXED-definition comparison (RAPGAP31 xFcut vs DJANGOH14 blind)

mixed_reproduction.note: reproduces the previously quoted mixed numbers exactly (14.57/18.52 max, 0.93/0.98 median); that pairing was RAPGAP31-xfcut vs DJANGOH14-blind

at_maxima_decomposition_pct.conclusion: at the maxima the mixed numbers were ~99% generator physics, not definition

median_level_pct.conclusion: at the median level the definition change contributed ~7-10% relative

definition_shift_z_confinement.note: confined to z<0.05 exactly as ruled in BLK-7.1: median |rel_def| = 0.000% in every z>=0.05 row; max 6.825/3.870 inside z<0.05, 1.551/1.076 in z 0.05-0.1, <=0.36% elsewhere

recommendation.component_name: c_rad_gen_rel (alias of the smoothing proposal's reserved crad_gen_envelope; its convention blocker is resolved by this note)
recommendation.definition: c_rad_gen_rel(bin) = 0.5 * GaussSmooth_pTrow(|rel(bin)|), rel = (C_rad_RAPGAP31 - C_rad_DJANGOH14)/C_rad_DJANGOH14 at matched xFGen<0 xFcut (both legs), EMPZ>45, nominal variant; Gaussian kernel exp(-0.5*(Delta_i)^2/sigma^2), sigma=1.0 pT-bin, edge-truncated renormalized within each (charge, (Q2,x) cell, z-row) five-point pT row — identical construction to phi_h_gauss_rel (kernel verified end-to-end vs gauss_smooth_perbin.csv to 1.4e-17)

decisions.symmetric_vs_one_sided: symmetric (signed spread has no stable direction: signed mean +0.322%/-0.173%, p5 -2.687%/-3.220%, p95 +5.246%/+3.383%, integrated -0.442%/-0.450%)
decisions.relative_vs_absolute: per-bin relative (C_rad is multiplicative; matches all *_rel budget components)
decisions.full_vs_half_difference: half-difference 0.5x, matching ibu_model_rel = 0.5*|IBU(R_DJ)-IBU(R_RG)|/nominal and phi_h_gauss_rel = 0.5*max_g smoothed|flat_g-nominal|; the user decision's per-bin DJANGOH-RAPGAP difference is the envelope input; full-difference variant is exactly x2 (see budget_impact.full_difference_sensitivity)
decisions.tail_treatment: Gaussian-smoothing envelope adopted; cap/floor/significance-gate rejected (gate would zero 152/245 and 153/245 sub-2-sigma bins; smoothing tames the stat-limited tail: bin 244 14.438%->5.872%, bin 489 18.317%->5.834%, bin 454 11.709%->3.806%; the tables' own MC-stat u_comb stays a separate future statistical term)
decisions.z_pT_dependence: no extra parametrization: per-bin term carries the z-structure (term z-row medians 0.31%/0.30% at z<0.05 rising to 1.18%/1.38% at z 0.7-1.0); smoothing confined to pT rows, never mixing z-rows

recommendation.nominal_table_untouched: the DJANGOH14 xFcut C_rad table itself is never smoothed/filled (radiative-correction rule); only the uncertainty envelope is smoothed
recommendation.status_label: PROVISIONAL DIAGNOSTIC until the xFcut baseline clears review and C_rad application is enabled

double_count_vs_ibu_model_rel.documented_overlap_is_phi_h_gauss: phi_h_gauss_rel README states it includes generator-model contamination; r(c_rad_gen, phi_h_gauss) = +0.654 (h+) / +0.570 (h-) — higher than the ibu_model correlation; c_rad_gen_rel adds no overlap phi_h_gauss_rel has not already introduced

charge_correlation_of_signed_input.note: comparable to ibu_model's documented +0.51; genuine coherent model difference, not white noise
